title: Dealing with Scabaras
start: Talk to the High Priest of Icthlarin in the south temple of Sophanem.

requirements.t: If Contact! was completed prior to the addition of Stolen Hearts and Diamond in the Rough, they must be completed before Dealing with Scabaras can be started.

items.t: Ugthanki dung (requires a bucket, this is not consumed)
10 unnoted gold artefacts from the Pyramid Plunder, including gold seals, golden scarabs, and golden statuettes
1 pyramid top from the Agility Pyramid
Up to 36 bronze gear or bronze bars (See distressing bronze gear)

recommended.t: The higher your Agility, Thieving, Strength and combat levels are above the required levels, the easier and shorter the quest becomes
Rope (for use on an optional agility shortcut)
Ring of charos for cheaper carpet rides
Desert amulet 2 for unlimited teleports to Nardah
Salve amulet to help damage the undead monsters
3-6 logs lightable at your Firemaking level minus 20
Keris to help damage scabarites and the giant scarab
Summer pie or agility potion, super strength (See room settings)

kills.t: Some of these types of monsters:

rewards.t: The ability to craft an enchanted water tiara - protects against desert heat

steps.t: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem. [Chat: 1 What news? › Accept]
p: Location of the ladder behind the altar in Sophanem.

steps.t: Climb the ladder behind the altar.
After the cutscene, talk to Maisa. [Chat: 1 Why are you here?]
Talk to the High Priest.
Go to the south-east of the Agility Pyramid, take the rope shortcut just to the east.

sub.t: If you haven't unlocked this shortcut, enter to the swamp south-east of Sophanem and go north, then climb the fallen pillar and the low wall. Last, use the rope on the rock.

steps.t: Climb over the low wall and talk to Lead archaeologist Abigail and Assistant archaeologist Kerner by the tents. Read their questions carefully and always round down the answer. [Chat: 1 I've had dealings with his sort before; feel free to test me.]
Talk to them again for an empty crate.
Fetch the bronze gear that are written in your quest journal.
At this point, if you have 60 Crafting, continue with the section Distressing by players.
Use the bronze gear on the crate.

Return to the archaeologists. This will take 3 hours so if 60 Crafting is achievable by any boosts within that time frame it is highly recommended to do that instead. [Chat: 1 Indeed, I am. › 1 Indeed, I would.]
Continue with the section Collecting scabarite notes.
While standing in the desert, use Ugthanki dung on the bronze items.
Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.
Travel to Pollnivneach (Pollnivneach Teleport or Magic carpet network are easiest).
Enter the kebab shop North-West of the well in the center of the town.
Talk to Isma'il the Kebab seller and purchase Red hot sauce [Chat: 3 Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?]
Head to the building South-West.
Go inside the fenced area with two Jasim the Camels.
Use the Red hot sauce on the trough to the South.
Use a bucket on the dung produced by Jasim the Camel to get Ugthanki dung.
While standing in the desert, use Ugthanki dung on the bronze items.
Use the oxidized bronze items on the crate.

Talk to Simon Templeton at the Agility Pyramid. [Chat: 1 Some archaeologists asked me to deliver some artefacts to you. › 1 I'd like to supply some gold objects from Pyramid Plunder. › 1 I'd like to supply a golden Agility Pyramid artefact. › 1 I'd like to supply a crate of bronze antiquities.]
Talk to the archaeologists (back at the campfire along the shortcut to the east) for a book scabaras research.
Kill undead creatures nearby until you get 4 different scabarite notes. They should have different examine texts.

sub.t: Dried zombies and skeletons to the north.
Locust lancers, rangers, scabaras lancers, and rangers in the swamp to the south-east.

steps.t: Copy the notes to the scabaras research.
Talk to the archaeologists for a key scabarite key.
Run north and enter the northernmost dungeon.

This section is a race against time. Read it fully before continuing. You need to pass all challenges successfully in one go, otherwise you need to tell the clay golem to reset the levers so you can try again.

It is possible to empty the storage box of logs so you might need to bring your own in case you fail at first attempt. If you have a lower Firemaking level, you might not be able to stoke the furnace. For example, the storage box may give you magic logs, but if your Firemaking level is below 95, you won't be able to continue, unless you bring your own logs.
Use the logs on the furnace to stoke the furnace.

Talk to the golem. [Chat: 3 I am ready for you to operate the levers. › 4 Set the mysterious box room to the highest power. › 1 Set the empty room to the second highest power. › 2 Set the narrow walkway room to the second lowest power.]
Relight the furnace.
Enter the narrow walkway room.

sub.t: Cross the pipe and pull the lever.

steps.t: Enter the empty room.
Enter the scarab room.
p: A safe location to attack the scarab from a distance.

steps.t: Enter the mysterious box room.

sub.t: Investigate the mysterious mechanism to start the puzzle. Clicking outside of the interface will fail the attempt and you'll have to start the whole process over.
Starting from the upper left corner, note the runes shown, flipping three runes in a row. Do this for all rows until all runes are noted. You should finish with 8 attempts left.

Click on the cog, mechanical screw parts and dial (three areas) on the right side of the interface to receive an extra 15 attempts giving 23 in total. You only need a minimum of 12 attempts, if you don't make any mistakes.

Flip the rune in the upper left corner. Use your notes to identify the locations of other matching runes and flip them over (You are matching groups of 3 runes). Continue until all runes have been flipped.

p: Click on the areas marked in red to get 15 additional attempts (35 in total)

steps.t: Once you have completed all 4 challenges in a row, it is possible to teleport out and restock without having to do them again.
p: Dealing with High Priest of Scabaras

steps.t: Run to the High Priest of Scabaras in the north-west room in the dungeon. Disarm the traps along the way.
Talk to the High Priest. [Chat: 2 Conversion, eh? › 2 I do not fear your pathetic beetle-brained magics.]
Defeat him.
Talk to him again. [Chat: 4 By all the deities, what is going on here? › 1 I sense the hand of the Devourer in this. Am I correct?]
Defeat him.
Talk to him once more. [Chat: 4 By all the deities, what is going on here? › 2 Sounds like the Devourer dragged you into heresy for her own ends.]
Defeat him.
Talk to him once more. [Chat: 2 Conversion, eh? › 1 I sense the hand of the Devourer in this. Am I correct?]
Return to the High Priest in Sophanem.
Quest complete!
